versions.changelog:
kuaishou-creator-screening v1.0.0

- Initial release of the快手达人筛选与KOL推荐 skill.
- Provides three core functions: 快手视频关键词搜索, 达人作品抓取 (根据主页链接获取作品列表), and 视频评论分析.
- Returns structured data on creators, works, and comments to support creator screening, content analysis, and audience evaluation.
- Does not require 快手 account login, processes only public data, and needs GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN.
- Includes detailed usage guidance, input rules, fail-safe/error handling, and environment requirements.
